//: Values verified against the running local stack, not assumed. Re-confirm against
actual `supabase start` output per the constitution's local-first rule.

ConnectionStrings.//: Local Supabase Postgres 17 on 54322 (config.toml [db] port). The service role
bypasses RLS, which is exactly why FR-063 requires every endpoint to authorize
independently. Never expose this to the browser.
Hangfire gets its own schema so it never collides with Supabase migrations.

Ai.//: Principle VIII: no model id or provider appears here or anywhere in code — they
live in the ai_model_registry table. Every seeded entry is enabled=false until
its license is recorded and the evaluation harness passes (VIII.4).

Budget.//: FR-055 enforced in token/image units until provider pricing is verified (R16).

Pipeline.//: Concurrent background jobs in this process. Each holds a DB connection while it
runs, so this is sized against the Supabase pool, not CPU count.

Storage.//: FR-001: the originals bucket has no UPDATE/DELETE policy for any application role.

Retention.//: FR-065: 3 years after listings.deleted_at. The purge job runs OUT OF BAND with its
own credential — the application identity must never hold delete rights on the
originals bucket, which is why this is not a Hangfire job.
